title: Interest
subtitle: 本課限定語境：interest = a feeling of wanting to know more about something, paying attention to i
description: 本課限定語境：interest = a feeling of wanting to know more about something, paying attention to it, or feeling enthusiasm for it · 「興趣；好奇；關注；熱衷」

words.note: 表示想知道、了解或探索更多的慾望。
words.example: The discovery sparked her curiosity about astronomy.
words.exampleZh: 這項發現激發了她對天文學的好奇心。

exercises.original: The strange object sparked her interest in how the machine worked.
exercises.zh: 這個奇怪物件激起她對機器運作方式的好奇心。
exercises.upgrade: The strange object sparked her curiosity about how the machine worked.

options.explanation: 只表示注意到，不一定想深入了解。
how the machine worked 直接表示想知道答案。
太偏積極熱情，不一定由未知問題觸發。

exercises.original: Her interest led her to ask several questions about the experiment.
exercises.zh: 她的好奇心令她對實驗提出數個問題。
exercises.upgrade: Her curiosity led her to ask several questions about the experiment.

options.explanation: 提問、想了解更多，是 curiosity 的核心。
也可能，但強度通常更高、更著迷。

exercises.original: Children often show strong interest in things they have never seen before.
exercises.zh: 兒童常對從未見過的東西表現出強烈好奇。
exercises.upgrade: Children often show strong curiosity about things they have never seen before.

options.explanation: 可以很興奮，但未知事物最直接引起 curiosity。
新奇、陌生事物令人想知道更多。
雖存在但遠不如 curiosity 自然。

words.note: 表示把注意力集中在某人、某事或某議題上。
words.example: The issue has attracted considerable public attention.
words.exampleZh: 這個議題引起了公眾廣泛關注。

exercises.original: The issue has attracted a lot of public interest.
exercises.zh: 這個議題引起了大量公眾關注。
exercises.upgrade: The issue has attracted a lot of public attention.

options.explanation: 表示熱情支持，不一定只是關注。
attract public attention 是標準搭配。
可能有人想了解，但 public attention 更中性。

exercises.original: The announcement generated considerable interest from the media.
exercises.zh: 這項公告引起媒體高度關注。
exercises.upgrade: The announcement generated considerable media attention.

options.explanation: 媒體對事件的關注最自然。
暗示媒體積極支持，題句未提供。
可以有好奇，但不如 attention 中性。

exercises.original: The report drew interest to a problem that had been ignored.
exercises.zh: 報告把注意力帶到一個一直被忽視的問題上。
exercises.upgrade: The report drew attention to a problem that had been ignored.

options.explanation: 可以增加公眾關心，但固定搭配是 draw attention to。
最自然、最精確的固定搭配。
技術性形容詞，不適合此處。

words.note: 表示對某事有強烈、積極而明顯的興趣。
words.example: Her enthusiasm for science was obvious.
words.exampleZh: 她對科學的熱情十分明顯。

exercises.original: Her interest in science was obvious from the way she talked about it.
exercises.zh: 從她談論科學的方式可以看出她非常熱衷。
exercises.upgrade: Her enthusiasm for science was obvious.

options.explanation: 明顯、積極、強烈的興趣最合適。
只是想了解，不一定充滿熱情。
不自然描述對學科的熱衷程度。

exercises.original: The students showed great interest in joining the new project.
exercises.zh: 學生對參加新項目表現出很大熱情。
exercises.upgrade: The students showed great enthusiasm for joining the new project.

options.explanation: show great enthusiasm for 是標準搭配，帶積極參與意願。
表示著迷，但未必想參與。

exercises.original: His interest in the sport has remained strong for years.
exercises.zh: 多年來，他對這項運動的熱情一直很強。
exercises.upgrade: His enthusiasm for the sport has remained strong for years.

options.explanation: 長期而積極的興趣很自然用 enthusiasm。
通常是想知道更多，不如 enthusiasm 表示長期熱衷。
不自然；標準名詞是 enthusiasm。

words.note: 表示某事令人非常著迷，想一直了解或觀察。
words.example: He has a lifelong fascination with space travel.
words.exampleZh: 他一生都對太空旅行深深著迷。

exercises.original: She has had a strong interest in ancient Egypt since childhood.
exercises.zh: 她從小就對古埃及深深著迷。
exercises.upgrade: She has had a fascination with ancient Egypt since childhood.

options.explanation: since childhood + strong interest 表示長期著迷。
也可能，但 fascination 更有「深深吸引」意味。
可以有吸引力，但不如 fascination 強。

exercises.original: His interest in how memory works led him to study psychology.
exercises.zh: 他對記憶如何運作深感著迷，因此修讀心理學。
exercises.upgrade: His fascination with how memory works led him to study psychology.

options.explanation: 興趣強到影響學習方向，最貼切。
更像投入活動，不一定是著迷。

exercises.original: The public's interest in the mystery continued for decades.
exercises.zh: 公眾對這個謎團的著迷持續了數十年。
exercises.upgrade: The public's fascination with the mystery continued for decades.

options.explanation: mystery + decades 是強烈持續著迷的典型語境。
可持續關注，但不如 fascination 強。
較像吸引力，不如 fascination 表示心理著迷。

words.note: 表示某人不只是注意，而是積極投入、參與或持續關注。
words.example: The new activities increased student engagement.
words.exampleZh: 新活動提升了學生投入程度。

exercises.original: The interactive lesson increased students' interest in the topic.
exercises.zh: 互動課堂提高了學生對主題的投入程度。
exercises.upgrade: The interactive lesson increased student engagement with the topic.

options.explanation: 也可能提升，但 interactive lesson 更強調參與。
學生積極參與、持續投入是核心。
表示熱情，但不直接等於參與程度。

exercises.original: The campaign aims to increase public interest in local decision-making.
exercises.zh: 這項活動旨在提升公眾對本地決策的參與和投入。
exercises.upgrade: The campaign aims to increase public engagement in local decision-making.

options.explanation: decision-making 語境中不只是關注，而是積極參與。
太強且語氣不合公民參與。

exercises.original: The new format kept audience interest high throughout the event.
exercises.zh: 新形式令觀眾在整場活動中保持高度投入。
exercises.upgrade: The new format kept audience engagement high throughout the event.

options.explanation: throughout the event 強調持續投入。
可以是其中一部分，但不足以表示整體投入。
也可能高，但 engagement 更適合衡量觀眾持續投入。
通常此義用不可數名詞。

words.note: 表示對某事有強烈興趣或很想做。
words.example: She showed great keenness to learn.
words.exampleZh: 她表現出很強的學習意願。

exercises.original: She showed strong interest in learning another language.
exercises.zh: 她表現出很強的學習另一種語言的意願。
exercises.upgrade: She showed great keenness to learn another language.

options.explanation: 可以著迷於語言，但不如 keenness 突出「很想學」。
keenness to learn 是自然搭配。

exercises.original: His interest in joining the team impressed the coach.
exercises.zh: 他積極想加入團隊的意願令教練印象深刻。
exercises.upgrade: His keenness to join the team impressed the coach.

exercises.original: The employer was pleased by her interest in taking on more responsibility.
exercises.zh: 僱主很欣賞她積極承擔更多責任的意願。
exercises.upgrade: The employer was pleased by her keenness to take on more responsibility.

options.explanation: 願意主動承擔更多責任，是典型 strong willingness。

words.note: 表示對某個議題、問題或他人的狀況感到在意。
words.example: There is growing public concern about air quality.
words.exampleZh: 公眾對空氣質素的關注日益增加。

exercises.original: There is growing public interest in air quality.
exercises.zh: 公眾對空氣質素的關注日益增加。
exercises.upgrade: There is growing public concern about air quality.

options.explanation: 對空氣質素問題通常不是「熱情」。
公共議題＋可能影響健康，最自然表示關注／憂慮。

exercises.original: The issue has become a matter of interest to local residents.
exercises.zh: 這個問題已成為本地居民關心的事情。
exercises.upgrade: The issue has become a matter of concern to local residents.

options.explanation: 只表示想知道，不一定在意後果。
a matter of concern 是標準搭配。
通常是形容詞「令人擔憂的」。

exercises.original: Parents expressed interest in the safety of the new playground.
exercises.zh: 家長表達了對新遊樂場安全的關注。
exercises.upgrade: Parents expressed concern about the safety of the new playground.

options.explanation: 安全問題通常不會令人著迷。
safety 是典型關心／擔憂語境。
可以想知道是否安全，但不足以表達家長在意。
雖可構造但極少用且此處需要名詞。

words.note: 表示某人因某事的吸引力而對它產生興趣。
words.example: One attraction of the course is its practical focus.
words.exampleZh: 這門課的一個吸引之處是實務導向。

exercises.original: One source of interest in the course is its practical focus.
exercises.zh: 這門課的一個吸引之處是它的實務導向。
exercises.upgrade: One attraction of the course is its practical focus.

options.explanation: 表示令課程吸引人的一個特點。
是人的感受，不是課程特色。

exercises.original: The main interest of the job is the opportunity to travel.
exercises.zh: 這份工作的主要吸引力是有機會旅行。
exercises.upgrade: The main attraction of the job is the opportunity to travel.

options.explanation: 這裡 interest 實際是「吸引之處」。

exercises.original: Part of the museum's interest lies in its unusual architecture.
exercises.zh: 博物館的一部分吸引力來自其不尋常建築。
exercises.upgrade: Part of the museum's attraction lies in its unusual architecture.

options.explanation: 表示 museum 對訪客的吸引力來源。
fascination 通常是人的著迷感，而非博物館本身的吸引點。

words.meaning: 好奇；因神秘感產生的興趣
words.note: 表示某事因神秘、新奇或未解之處而引起興趣。
words.example: The unexplained result created considerable intrigue.
words.exampleZh: 這個無法解釋的結果引起了相當大的好奇與興趣。

exercises.original: The unexplained result created a great deal of interest among researchers.
exercises.zh: 無法解釋的結果在研究人員之間引起大量好奇。
exercises.upgrade: The unexplained result created a great deal of intrigue among researchers.

options.explanation: 如果結果令人擔憂可用，但題句重點是未解之謎。
unexplained 是典型神秘感線索。
也可，但 intrigue 更具神秘好奇感。

exercises.original: The mysterious message immediately generated interest online.
exercises.zh: 神秘訊息立即在網上引起好奇。
exercises.upgrade: The mysterious message immediately generated intrigue online.

options.explanation: 也可，但 intrigue 更直接和 mystery 搭配。
神秘訊息引起猜測與好奇，最自然。
可引起注意，但沒有神秘好奇層次。

exercises.original: The missing detail added interest to the story.
exercises.zh: 缺失的細節為故事增加了神秘感和吸引力。
exercises.upgrade: The missing detail added intrigue to the story.

options.explanation: 缺失資訊令故事更神秘、更引人猜想。
不自然說 add attention to a story 作此義。

falseSynonyms.zh: 嗜好 ≠ 興趣本身 hobby 是你經常從事的休閒活動。 interest 可以只是想了解某事。
熱愛 ≠ 一般 interest passion 通常更強、更持久。
好奇 ≠ 所有 interest curiosity 需要「想知道更多」。 對音樂有 interest 不一定是 curiosity。
注意 ≠ 必然感興趣 你可以因為警告、危險或責任而給某事 attention。
關心／憂慮 ≠ 一般興趣 concern 常帶重要性或擔憂。
享受 ≠ 興趣 你可能對某議題很有興趣，但未必享受它。
詞形陷阱 - interest = 興趣；使感興趣 - interested = 感興趣的 - interesting = 令人感興趣的
詞形不同 - enthusiasm = 熱情 - enthusiastic = 熱情的
